supporting_role: multi-stage ethanol evaporation and wave-multiplicity evidence

target_questions.question: How does droplet-size-dependent multi-stage evaporation alter reaction-zone width, local explosions, and wave multiplicity?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 D009 links evaporation scale to wave response; this ethanol study adds multi-stage phase-change and wave-birth behavior.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The ethanol RDE simulations resolve initial refill-zone evaporation followed by droplet-size-dependent secondary/post-detonation evaporation; these stages broaden the reaction zone and participate in extinction, local explosion, shock collision, and changes in wave multiplicity.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: Droplet size and inlet conditions are varied in an Eulerian-Lagrangian model with simultaneous vapor and liquid ethanol injection.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: evaporation-scale control of rotating-detonation wave response

limitations: Numerical ethanol configuration with prevaporized co-injection; wave-multiplicity transitions are case-specific.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
